item.title: IDF kills Radwan Force special operations commander in southern Lebanon strike
item.description: Abu Khalil Barji, who commanded Hezbollah’s Radwan Force special operations unit, was killed along with two other operatives; military said the unit planned and carried out attacks against its forces

item.title: Ambitious Mossad plan to spark Iran uprising seems to fall short as war drags on
item.description: Trump and Netanyahu embraced an optimistic strategy of assassinations and covert efforts to trigger unrest, but intelligence officials say fear of Iran’s security forces has so far prevented mass protests or a broader revolt

item.title: ‘You won’t defeat us, not even with 300 kilograms of explosives’: families return to rubble in southern Israel
item.description: Less than a day after the strikes in Dimona and Arad, a resident found his wife’s ring in the rubble; nearly 200 wounded were rushed to Soroka, where a veteran ER chief said, 'I’ll remember the bleeding children,' families said, 'Trauma is trauma — and now more than ever'

item.title: דם שחור

item.title: היעדים הנכונים
item.description: ישראל משקיעה יותר מדי משאבים בניסיונות לחסל בכירים ולמוטט את המשטר באיראן במקום להתמקד בהעמקת הפגיעה במתקני הגרעין, הטילים והתעשיות הצבאיות. זה נובע מחולשה בהבנת האויב – מהסוג שהוביל גם למחדלי 7 באוקטובר
